messages.content: I’m ready to finish Minneapolis. Before you book, compare the actual totals and make sure Tuesday registration and the Friday noon meeting are protected.

The selected 9:05 a.m. Tuesday nonstop arrives at 11:58 a.m. Its complete round-trip total with the 6:35 p.m. Friday nonstop is $329, including taxes; one checked bag would add $70 round trip. The cheaper Tuesday flight arrives at 3:40 p.m. and lowers the fare to $286, but that leaves only 1 hour 50 minutes before 5:30 registration, before allowing for a checked bag or the trip downtown. The earlier flight gives you roughly five and a half hours.
How long should I allow from the airport to the Warehouse hotel?

Light rail to the Warehouse District takes about 35 to 45 minutes including the walk and wait, then roughly five minutes on foot to the hotel. A rideshare is commonly 20 to 30 minutes but can run longer in afternoon traffic. With the 11:58 arrival, even checking a bag and using rail should put you at the hotel around 1:15 to 1:40 p.m.
Good. Keep the 9:05. Now walk me through Friday. My meeting is scheduled until noon and I’ll need to collect my suitcase.

For the 2:20 p.m. nonstop, you would need the meeting to end exactly on time, retrieve the bag immediately, and leave downtown around 12:25. That is fragile. The 5:10 p.m. nonstop costs $18 less than the 6:35 but still leaves a comfortable transfer; the 6:35 keeps your selected $329 itinerary and gives you more time, though you would wait longer at the airport.
Could I leave the suitcase with conference registration instead of going back to the hotel?

Yes. Registration will hold one suitcase Friday, so you can check out before the morning program, bring the bag to the conference, and collect it after the noon meeting. For the 6:35 flight, picking it up by 12:15 and leaving around 3:30 would put you at the airport near 4:00, with ample time even if traffic slows.
Then book the 9:05 outbound and 6:35 return at $329. I’ll check one bag both ways, so include that in the amount I should expect.

The flights are ticketed. Tuesday departs Denver at 9:05 a.m. and arrives Minneapolis at 11:58 a.m.; Friday departs at 6:35 p.m. and arrives Denver at 7:52 p.m. Airfare is $329.00, and the expected checked-bag charges are $70.00, paid at check-in, for a total flight cost of $399.00. Airline confirmation: D7K4MP.
Now reserve the Warehouse District hotel for Tuesday through Friday. Standard king is fine. Confirm the full cost and cancellation terms first.

The standard king for April 13-16 is $516 before tax and the mandatory facilities charge. The guaranteed three-night total is $588.72. Nothing is prepaid; payment is due at checkout. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Minneapolis time on Sunday, April 11. After that, the penalty is one night plus tax. The hotel also confirms luggage storage after Friday checkout.
That works. Book it and give me the final schedule, including when I should deal with the bag on Friday.

The Warehouse District hotel is reserved for three nights, April 13-16, in one standard king. Hotel confirmation: WHD-413-82716. Guaranteed total: $588.72, due at checkout; free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. local time April 11.

Tuesday: depart Denver nonstop at 9:05 a.m., arrive Minneapolis at 11:58, collect your checked bag, and take rail or a rideshare downtown. You should reach the hotel around 1:15 to 1:40 p.m., well before 5:30 registration. Wednesday’s panel and Thursday’s appointments and dinner remain unchanged. Friday: check out before the conference, leave the suitcase at registration, attend the noon meeting through its scheduled end, and retrieve the bag around 12:15 p.m. You can remain downtown for lunch or work, then leave for the airport around 3:30 for the 6:35 p.m. nonstop, arriving Denver at 7:52 p.m. Flights and hotel are confirmed; expected combined air, bag, and hotel cost is $987.72, excluding local transportation.
